component.name: Selviana Desktop Environment
component.summary: Small and fast desktop environment with a modern look

description.p: The Selviana Desktop Environment (SDE) is a small and fast desktop with a modern look. It includes the panel with the Start menu, the desktop with icons and wallpapers, the session manager, notifications, the run dialog and the Control Center.
SDE programs are built with SDE-FLTK, the SDE fork of FLTK 1.3 by Bill Spitzak and others. SDE is inspired by the Equinox Desktop Environment (EDE) and contains no EDE code.
Developed by the Selviana DE Project. Selviana Desktop Environment, SDE and the SDE logo are trademarks of the Selviana DE Project.
